messages:
Sofia: Heads up — after merging model-onboard/ckpt-v2.1 the staging perf p99 spiked ~2.8x on text-gen. Can we pause rollout? /cc @deploy-bot :eyes:
Eli: Saw it. p50 looks fine but p99 jumped from ~120ms -> ~340ms on coralv2 nodes. Quick profile shows kernel fallback to slow matmul path + increased KV cache misses.
ci-bot: Staging perf test failed: https://ci.internal/builds/12345 — summary: gen_latency_p99=348ms (baseline 122ms). Full logs attached.
infra-bot: Flamegraph uploaded: https://profiler.internal/fg/xyz — top functions: kv_cache_lookup, choose_kernel, fallback_gemm
Maya: I suspect tokenizer changes in the onboard PR. The PR added whitespace normalization and a new `token_start` that inserts a leading token, which shifts the KV keying and sequence length distribution. That can change batching heuristics and kernel selection.
Ryan: Running git bisect now between merge commit and previous. Quick bisect points to commit 9a3f2b (author: anna) — diff touches tokenizer.normalize and model_config.token_start.
Sofia: Diff snippet from 9a3f2b:
`````
- def encode(text, strip_special_tokens=True):
+ def encode(text, normalize_whitespace=True):
      tokens = base_tokenize(text)
+     if normalize_whitespace:
+         tokens = _normalize(tokens)
+     if model_config.token_start:
+         tokens.insert(0, model_config.token_start)
`````
Eli: Repro locally with harness: `./tools/perf/run_profile --model ckpt-v2.1 --warmup 20 --requests 500` -> p99=348ms. Patch tokenizer to skip insert -> p99=128ms. So it's reproducible.
Ryan: Proposed immediate mitigation: runtime compatibility shim to strip the extra leading token from KV key calc and force original kernel selection rules. PR #2234 opened (workflow: shadow + canary).
Maya: I think safer path is to revert the tokenizer change in the onboarding PR, then rework tokenizer to preserve KV key behavior. Will open revert PR.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for ckpt-v2.1 paused. Traffic pinned to v2.0. :thumbsup:
Sofia: Revert PR opened: https://git.internal/r/456 — cc perf tests re-run. Waiting on CI.
ci-bot: Perf CI for revert PR queued. Expected ETA ~30m. I'll post results.
Eli: Follow-up: we'll add a unit test to the tokenizer -> runtime contract asserting consistent KV-keying and that `token_start` doesn't change effective seq-length distribution used by scheduler.
Sofia: Good. After revert and tests we'll re-onboard with a tokenizer migration plan. Thanks folks :heart:
